name: PNC Process Systems Co., Ltd.
summary: PNC Process Systems Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells semiconductor process equipment, system integration and support equipment, and electronic materials in China. The company operates through System Integration, Electronic Materials, and Equipment Business segments. It provides professional services. The company offers its products to electronics, biology, and energy industries. PNC Process Systems Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Shanghai, China.
